answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. An agent burns 50 credits to claim one slot, which opens after the deposit clears and a task is verified. A forger wanting 1,000 slots burns 50,000 credits upfront; the delta between one honest deposit and that bulk cost makes fakery unprofitable. The slot carries an ivory badge, and later conduct must mirror the claimed history or it closes. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
